scope.audience: Visitors and reviewers who want to read the 6529 Network Museum's records and texts and see that each one is the exact record the Museum published on Ethereum
scope.primary_task: Find a work, artist or text in the Museum's on-chain record, read it, and see that it was verified against the chain
scope.release_intent: New unlinked, noindex preview route that reads the Museum from the Sepolia ProvenanceRegistry test deployment and 6529 IPFS, and shows each record only after its bytes hash to the on-chain digest. It is meant to replace /museum/network after testing, on the owner's go.

decisions: The route set is outside /museum/network on purpose: the /museum/network layout loads the GitHub publication for its shell, and this preview trusts only the chain and IPFS. It therefore does not use the Museum shell or navigation.

Works are shown without images. Media files are not committed on-chain and not pinned on 6529 IPFS; their SHA-256 sits only in the verified catalog. Showing an unverified image would break the preview's rule that nothing is shown before it matches the chain. Whether to pin media and show verified images is an owner decision.

The record route has 588 instances across 11 record types. The six record cells are the distinct templates: a work entity, an artist entity, a relation, an accession object record (WORK_DESCRIPTION), a long text and a short text.

Failure states (record hash mismatch, content unavailable, deleted, registry unavailable) are implemented and unit tested but cannot be produced against the live registry, where all 588 records verify; only the default state is pinned.

Console errors in automated-checks.json come from the local server's API endpoint setting (requests to localhost:3000 for site settings and cookie consent, refused by CSP). They come from the site shell on every route of a locally served build and are not part of this change.
J13 applies because the surface presents chain state (contract checks, hashes, addresses, releases). The surface has no wallet prompt, signature or transaction, so S1-S6 are not applicable.

Tiles: each capture has viewport-height tiles (-01.png onward), at most 14 per capture; automated-checks.json marks captures whose tiles stop before the page ends (tilesTruncated). The full-page capture (-full.png) and text/<slug>-<viewport>.txt cover the whole page.

evidence_index.captures: evidence/<slug>-<viewport>-full.png full-page captures, evidence/<slug>-<viewport>-NN.png viewport-height tiles, evidence/text/<slug>-<viewport>.txt (text of <main>), evidence/automated-checks.json, evidence/contact-sheet-<viewport>.png
evidence_index.live_build: Production build of the candidate served at http://localhost:3001 while the round is judged
